evidence_slice: The official University of Exeter Streatham Campus Map PDF identifies the Forum as building 3 within the campus building key and visually draws the Forum as a building shape on the Streatham campus map. The inspected rendered map is a cartographic campus plan and does not publish a georeferenced CRS, British National Grid vertex coordinates, or a machine-readable Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry for the Forum feature. No physical building footprint coordinates were inferred from the drawing.

field_evidence.footprint: Official campus map visually draws Forum building 3, but no georeferenced CRS, BNG vertex coordinates, or machine-readable record-level Polygon/MultiPolygon is published.
field_evidence.type_use: Official University campus map explicitly identifies Forum as building 3 in the campus building key.
